title: Croatian Fired Casserole
description: A hearty casserole dish made with fired vegetables and Croatian spices, perfect for a cold evening.

ingredients.name: Croatian sausage
ingredients.notes: Fired sausage can be substituted for regular sausage if desired

ingredients.name: Mixed fired vegetables
ingredients.notes: Choose your favorite fired vegetables such as bell peppers, onions, and mushrooms

instructions: Cook the Croatian sausage in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the mixed fired vegetables to the skillet and cook until they are tender, about 5 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the vegetable broth and Croatian seasoning.
Pour the broth mixture over the sausage and vegetables in the skillet.
Transfer the mixture to the casserole dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes.
